asset.name: Complaint acknowledgement
asset.description: Sent to the customer as soon as the complaint is logged, with the case number and response target.
asset.subject: We have received your complaint ({{case_number}})
asset.html_body:
We are looking into it

Hi {{customer_name}},

Thank you for letting us know about the problem with {{=IF(IS_EMPTY(order_number), "your account", CONCAT("order ", order_number))}}. Your case number is {{case_number}}.

A member of our team will contact you within {{first_response_hours}} hours, and we aim to resolve it by {{resolution_due_date}}.

Reply to this email if you have anything to add.

Customer care, your company
